name: Regime + Bollinger-z trend-extension arms momentum (macro gate beyond a price-stretch band)
rationale: THESIS: bb_z (BOUNDED z-score of price vs its Bollinger band) measures how stretched price is relative to its own recent range. A MILD positive bb_z is the signature of a healthy breakout (price pulling away from the mean with conviction) without yet being a blow-off (which a very high bb_z flags). The macro_regime gate decides whether that breakout is in a tape worth trusting. Entry: macro_regime>floor AND bb_z BETWEEN [bbz_lo, bbz_hi] (mild trend-extension, not a blow-off) AND ret_Nd>mom_floor. This is distinct from raw momentum because bb_z normalizes the breakout by the asset's own volatility. DISCONFIRMER: run the SAME entry with macro_regime DROPPED but the bb_z mild-extension band kept (bb_z-gated momentum). If the bb_z-only version reproduces the macro+bb_z net-of-fee Sharpe, the macro gate is redundant to a price-stretch breakout filter and carries no orthogonal macro information — falsified. The macro gate must add net edge over the bb_z-only band.
catalyst: Risk-on macro regime with price in a mild-extension Bollinger-z band (healthy breakout, not blow-off) and positive trend — the window arms a normalized-momentum entry.
